paragraphs: R' Parnakh. R' Yohanan said: Shabbat 14a; Sukkah 32b; Mo'ed Katan 9a; Niddah 26a. Also R' Berekhya and R' Helbo in R' Yohanan's name: Shabbat 37a; Hullin 48a. In R' Hanina's name: Jerusalem Talmud, Tamid Nishhat, halakhah 7, and the end of Ta'anit chapter 3. R' Hinena, Rav Mattana, Yosi bar Menasha in Rav's name: Jerusalem Talmud, beginning of Lulav Ha-Gazul. Hizkiyah bar R' Parnakh said that R' Yohanan said.
